g.text: Final Fig.12: complete saved states versus published vectors
4 scenes x 12 thresholds x 2 methods; 96 published points and 192 derived language points
Threshold labels differ: paper uses W; completed input banks use I/N. Shared numeric ticks disclose this unresolved mapping.
Original-reference agreement remains unverified. Configured 1000 draws validate channel moments, not optimized-performance averages.
